subject: TAKING nord2_metal_bridge.c alloc()/map_bo()/heap/TLS/matrix/n2mb_copy for P6 GPU-only + IOSurface acquire; bridge test fake
body: Editing now (re-read first): struct bo (+gpu_only), alloc() treats its exec arg as kernel flags (bit0 exec, bit1 GPU-only) with an old-kernel fallback (BAD -> retry without bit1, remembered), map_bo refuses GPU-only, heap/TLS/WLS allocated GPU-only, tiler matrix uses its own mapped heap and drops it so the persistent heap is GPU-only, geometry trace skips a GPU-only heap, n2mb_copy acquires (SYNC to CPU) an imported source before reading it. Your cmdpool/clear-slot/async code is not touched; alloc()'s retry chain stays as is. Frontend audit result so far (your files, no edit): getBytes/replaceRegion on imported textures, tegu_shadow_copy, pixel probe and grid trace all lock/unlock the IOSurface correctly.
